item.title: Fentanyl, marijuana, firearms seized in Kershaw drug bust
item.description: Justin Smith, of Kershaw, was arrested Wednesday after deputies served a search warrant on his home and found 85.66 grams of suspected fentanyl, pills, digital scales, suspected marijuana, a .40 caliber pistol, and a loaded magazine, as well as $8,189 cash.

item.description: Mecklenburg County officials have declared a state of emergency due to the winter storm, and city leaders are urging residents to use 311 for non-emergency issues such as frozen pipes and downed trees.

item.title: 'It’s once a decade here': Families rush for sleds, supplies as winter weather approaches
item.description: Families in the Carolinas are preparing for a rare snow day by stocking up on cold-weather essentials and searching for sleds, while emergency officials are urging residents to stay informed and use extra caution if they have to be on the roads.

item.title: Brace for heavy snow and freezing cold this weekend
item.description: A snowstorm is expected to bring up to 8 inches of snow to the Piedmont and Foothills, with even higher totals in the mountains, creating difficult travel conditions and an Extreme Cold Warning in effect for the weekend.
